user.title: Meshtastic UI
user.description: Connect directly to your Meshtastic radio. Choose a connection type.

tcp.title: TCP Connection
tcp.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Meshtastic radio.

serial.title: Serial Connection
serial.description: Enter the serial device path for your Meshtastic radio.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up Meshtastic radio
zeroconf_confirm.description:
A Meshtastic radio was discovered on the network:

**{name}**
`{host}:{port}`

Do you want to set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the radio. Check the address and ensure the radio is powered on.

init.title: Home Assistant entities
init.description: Pick the mesh nodes that get their own device with battery, telemetry, signal and location entities. Your own radio always has them. Sensors appear once a node reports each reading.

trigger_type.direct_message_from_node: Authenticated direct message received from this node

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a text message to a channel, or a direct message to one node.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send, up to 228 bytes.

to.name: To
to.description: Node ID or exact name for a direct message. Leave empty to post on the channel.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel index (0 is the primary channel).

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Which radio to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

send_waypoint.name: Send waypoint
send_waypoint.description: Shares a map waypoint with the mesh.

expire_hours.name: Expires after
expire_hours.description: Hours until the waypoint disappears. 0 keeps it.
